mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ftp_task_credential ( task_id, user_id, auth_mode, encrypted_username, encrypted_password, username_nonce, password_nonce, key_id, cipher_version, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{credential.taskId}, #{credential.userId}, #{credential.authMode}, #{credential.encryptedUsername}, #{credential.encryptedPassword}, #{credential.usernameNonce}, #{credential.passwordNonce}, #{credential.keyId}, #{credential.cipherVersion}, #{credential.createdAt}, #{credential.updatedAt}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ftp_task_credential WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
